Accounting Registry
https://accountingregistry.org/

Purpose:
International reference registry for accounting across jurisdictions.

Coverage:
- International
- Jurisdiction-based
- Country-level accounting environments
- Cross-border accounting relevance

Content focus:
- Accounting as a professional operating function
- Authorities
- Legislation
- Process flow
- Required documents
- Reporting environment
- Operational practice
- Cross-border considerations
- Practical guidance

Structure:
- Homepage
- Jurisdictions index
- Individual jurisdiction records

Editorial model:
Each record covers one professional domain in one jurisdiction and is written as an editorial reference rather than a marketing page.

Style:
Neutral, structured, professional, factual, non-promotional.

Best summary:
Accounting Registry is an international, jurisdiction-based reference system explaining how accounting works in practice across countries and regulatory environments.
